title: Pool reactor
label: TRIGA pool reactor in half section: a tall shield cut open on six metres of blue-lit water, the low core with four hanging rods, a beam tube, bridge drives, coolant loops, gauge console, pump skid, rails, ladder and beam port.
caption: Six metres of water shield and cool the core, and the blue Cherenkov light gathers round it. Drag to move the four rods: withdrawn 62 % the reactor holds 1.0 MW with an infinite period; drop them and it scrams; pull them all and it pulses.
